title: Inefficient string construction
summary: Repeated format! or push_str patterns that allocate avoidably while building large strings.
rationale: String construction choices affect allocation behavior in serializers, templates, and exporters.

detection.notes: Look for repeated format! in loops or string building without capacity planning.

impact.notes: Impact increases in hot paths, large inputs, high-concurrency services, build pipelines, or repeated request paths.

remediation.guidance: Use String::with_capacity, write!, buffered writers, or streaming serialization.
remediation.tradeoffs: Capacity estimates can be wrong; avoid over-optimizing small strings.
